# Soil Health PWA — FastAPI Backend

Python REST API backend using **FastAPI** for the Soil Health PWA.

## Stack

| Layer | Tech |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Python 3.13 |
| Framework | **FastAPI** |
| Server | Uvicorn (ASGI) |
| Validation | Pydantic v2 |
| Storage | In-memory dict (swap for SQLite/PostgreSQL) |

## Quick Start

```bash
cd backend

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Run dev server (auto-reload)
uvicorn main:app --reload --port 3001
```

Server starts at **http://localhost:3001**

## Interactive API Docs (auto-generated by FastAPI 🎉)

| URL | Description |
|---|---|
| http://localhost:3001/docs | **Swagger UI** — test all endpoints interactively |
| http://localhost:3001/redoc | ReDoc — clean API reference |
| http://localhost:3001/openapi.json | Raw OpenAPI schema |

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/` | API info |
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Server health & uptime |
| `POST` | `/api/analyze` | Run soil analysis |
| `GET` | `/api/reports` | List all reports + trend |
| `GET` | `/api/reports/{id}` | Get single report |
| `DELETE` | `/api/reports/{id}` | Delete a report |

## Project Structure

```
backend/
├── main.py          ← FastAPI app, CORS, routers
├── engine.py        ← Soil analysis business logic
├── db.py            ← In-memory data store
├── models.py        ← Pydantic request/response schemas
├── requirements.txt
└── routers/
    ├── health.py    ← GET  /api/health
    ├── analyze.py   ← POST /api/analyze
    └── reports.py   ← GET/DELETE /api/reports
```
